title: Petar Meseldžija's New Blog
content: Petar Meseldžija has started a blog. The second post starts with the proverb: “ There is no shortcut to the place that is truly worthwhile of being at.”Seeing his sketches, photo reference, and closeup details shows how true that proverb is.---------Petar Meseldžija ArtPreviously on GJ:Steel BashawThanks,Dragan
